name: handoff-freshness-gate-v0.1
purpose: Prevent execution of a handoff whose premise has been superseded by newer evidence.
decision: fresh: no newer evidence contradicts or supersedes premise claims
stale: newer evidence changes a premise required by the handoff objective
unknown: evidence cannot be compared safely
rule: stale handoffs are not executed as-is; regenerate from current evidence.
boundary: Freshness is about premise currency, not truth of the newer evidence itself.
